name: distortionz_flock
changelog: v2.0.0 — MERGED: distortionz_speedcam absorbed as a second camera mode. Config.Cameras entries now take a `modes` field ('alpr', 'speed', or both) instead of being ALPR-only. Speed detection is now fully server-authoritative (was client-reported in distortionz_speedcam) — plate and speed are both derived server-side on the same scan pass as ALPR. ADDED: automatic BOLO ping — every plate read is checked against distortionz_cad's active Vehicle BOLOs and alerts police, independent of the hotlist. REMOVED: the live camera feed system (StartFeed/StopFeed exports, Config.FeedControl, Config.FeedTraffic) and distortionz_cad's Cameras tab. BREAKING: Config.Cameras entries require `modes`; the GetCameras export was removed (CAD integration no longer needs it).
